Buttermilk

1 cup flour

1 cup corn flour

2 tbsp. ghee

2 tsp. mustard seed

1 tsp. fenugreek

1 tsp. jasmint seeds

salt

A handful chopped garlic

1 onion finely chopped

2 green chilli finely chopped

juice of half an orange

4-5 medium potatoes (slaw diced into small cubes)

1 tsp. ginger paste

2-3 tangerine peels

3-4 tamarind pods

3 boiled potatoes

2-3 green chillies

1 tbsp. oil

1 tsp. salt

oil for deep frying

curry leaves (optional)

For the dough

2-3 tbsp. wheat flour

salt to taste

Method:

Wheat flour or corn flour is mixed with ghee and salt together and kept aside.

Oil for deep frying is heated and all the mixture is quickly mixed into the oil. Mix well and make into a thick dough.

Leave this in an airtight container, and refrigerate until required.

Now, a potato slaw is made from boiled potatoes.

For the aloo tikki

the dough (plain part) can be kept aside for a few hours.

Take the plain dough, a lil more than half of the quantity, and give it a squeeze to make it into a ball.

Now take this ball of dough and roll it into a circle.

Cut it and roll it again to make another circle.
This ball and the previous round are made into balls.

To prepare one round of dough, cut it into 1 inch thickness. This round is now taken separately.

Take these in palms of your hands.

Take the second round of dough, which was not cut earlier and keep aside.

Now take the round of dough and cover it with the round of the plain dough. You can use a rolling pin.

Roll this like the plain dough and cut it into bite size pieces.

Place these patties in between the plain ones and then roll them in the plain ones.

Cut them in to small bite size pieces.

Place these patties into a deep plate, cover with the plain dough ball and roll it a few times to make the patties stick.

Cover these patties with oil, as soon as the oil gets hot, put the patties on it and fry them.

Dont fry too long or they will become crispy.

Remove and drain on a tissue paper, which will dry the oil.

Add salt and green chillies to taste.

Add green chilies for more flavour.
Serve hot with a tomato ketchup.

Enjoy ur Aloo Tikki. Hope u’ll like it.
